title: docs: ADR-0019's enforcement log still lists a hand-built packages[] body as not judged, after #33074 and #33122
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvfX5bawZKtfa6u7j9

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up two contract reviews surfaced (6848214183 ③ on PR #33074, 6858193093 ③ on PR #33122). Governed text, so neither PR edited it.
Business reason: ADR-0019 is the page an author or agent reads to learn which single-app and namespace rules strict `defineStack` enforces on a multi-package stack. It now says a hand-built `packages[]` body is not judged, which has been false since #33074 (single-app, per body) and #33122 (namespace prefix, per body). A reader trusting it would skip validation they now get.
Reader who acts: whoever owns ADR text (governed surface; a Tier H docs PR).

## 维护者速读

ADR-0019 的执行记录停在 #32586，仍写着手工拼的 `packages[]` 包体不受检查；#33074 和 #33122 合并后，严格 `defineStack` 已按包分别检查单应用和命名空间前缀。需要在 ADR 的 Status / 执行记录里补这两条。

## Expected

ADR-0019's Status line and enforcement log name #33074 (the single-app rule judges a `packages[]` stack per body plus residual top-level apps) and #33122 (the namespace-prefix rule judges each body against its own namespace, residual top-level objects against the stack's), and drop the "hand-built `packages[]` body is not judged" sentence.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open ADR-0019` checked at filing. Related: #32978, #33069, #32898.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
